北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感-2℃，出门别忘添衣，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and feels like -2℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风力 5 级，体感 3℃，风大天冷，记得防风保暖！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has strong winds and feels like 3℃. Stay warm and guard against the wind!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，体感 4℃，早晚温差大，别忘了添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and feels like 4℃. Mind the temperature difference, dress accordingly.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗，体感 10℃，风力 4 级，注意防风别着凉！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny, feels like 10℃ with strong winds. Stay warm!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴天，体感 12℃，凉爽舒适，风力 3 级，适度添衣。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and feels like a comfortable 12℃. Dress appropriately.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 7℃，微凉，记得加件外套防风哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny and feels a bit cool at 7℃. Remember a jacket for the breeze.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 4℃，风力 4 级，出门注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and feels like 4℃ with winds. Stay warm and guard against the wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴好，体感 11℃ 舒适，早晚微凉，小心温差。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and feels comfortable at 11℃. Mind the morning/evening chill.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗，体感 8℃，风力 4 级，出门添衣，注意防风。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and feels like 8℃ with winds. Dress warmly and stay protected from wind.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 6℃，空气干燥，多喝水，注意保湿哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels like 6℃. It's dry, so drink water and moisturize!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 9℃ 较舒适，但湿度 51% 别着凉。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels comfortable at 9℃. Mind the 51% humidity.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感-25℃，风力 5 级，严寒来袭，务必全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -25℃ with strong winds. Bundle up thoroughly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 5级

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感-14℃，风力 5 级，寒风刺骨，出门注意保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels like -14℃ with strong winds. It's biting cold, dress warmly!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 2℃，湿度 82%，注意防潮保暖别感冒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels like 2℃. High humidity, stay warm and avoid colds.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 8℃，风力 4 级，风较大，注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and feels like 8℃ with strong winds. Stay warm and guard against the wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感-2℃，风力 4 级，出门多穿点，注意防寒。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels like -2℃ with winds. Dress warmly and stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感-10℃，风力 5 级，风大天冷，务必做好保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -10℃ with strong winds. It's cold and windy, ensure you stay warm.
